verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an import tool for passwords and other items from other password managers, and built-in TOTP generation for saved logins. Nothing documents bulk import of TOTP tokens from dedicated authenticator apps, so the password-manager importer is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Missing: any documented import path from authenticator apps.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: With our import tool, you can migrate passwords and other items from most major password managers in just a few minutes.
